editorial.notes: The heading printed over a reading from the Acts of the Apostles. LÉCTIO is the nominative of a heading: no verb is expressed or understood. ÁCTUUM is the genitive plural of actus, the book named by its title; APOSTOLÓRUM depends on it. The page sets the capital of Áctuum without its acute, which the house orthography restores.

source.method: The Latin follows the Benziger Brothers 1962 editio iuxta typicam, which prints this heading over the Epistle on printed p. 350 (IA leaf n431 / PDF p. 432) and over the 6 further readings named in the witness header; it is compared with the heading line of the pinned Divinum Officium file that the reading's own digital witness binds. The house orthography restores the acute on the capital of Áctuum. Source review remains pending.
